history.body: Hi, I am browsing homes around Seberang Jaya. How much does Pearl Residences start from?

An indicative starting reference is RM301,760, calculated from a RM328,000 base for a Podium Blocked unit on levels 1–4 using the 8% rebate shown in the 14 August 2026 package snapshot. That’s a dated reference, not a currently confirmed offer or all-in price; the exact unit, applicable car-park or other components, and latest package need confirmation. Phase 1 units are 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. If you have a rough budget in mind, I can help you assess whether it may be worth exploring further.
